Class SudokuValidator

java.lang.Object
com.example.sudoku.model.SudokuValidator
All Implemented Interfaces:
IValidator
public class SudokuValidator extends Object implements IValidator
Implementation of the Sudoku validator that checks if moves are valid. Validates entries based on Sudoku rules for 6x6 boards with 2x3 blocks.

  • Method Details

    • isValidate

      public boolean isValidate(SudokuBoard board, int row, int column, int value)
      Validates if a value can be placed at the specified position. A value is valid if it doesn't appear in the row, column, or 2x3 block.
      Specified by:
      isValidate in interface IValidator
      Parameters:
      board - the 6x6 Sudoku board
      row - the row index
      column - the column index
      value - the value to validate (1-6)
      Returns:
      true if the value is valid for this position, false otherwise

    • isBlock

      public boolean isBlock(SudokuBoard board, int row, int column, int value)
      Checks if a value already exists in the 2x3 block containing the specified position. For a 6x6 board, blocks are arranged in 3 rows and 2 columns of 2x3 cells.
      Specified by:
      isBlock in interface IValidator
      Parameters:
      board - the 6x6 Sudoku board
      row - the row index
      column - the column index
      value - the value to check (1-6)
      Returns:
      true if the value exists in the block, false otherwise
